1.explanation: In the Simulator (specifically in connection-pool.js), we group all records by origin and pull in serverResponseTimeByOrigin with a default fallback (30 ms). Data URIs come in with scheme='data' and an empty or literal 'data' securityOrigin, so they fall through to that default. The snippet above constructs a data URI request, runs the Simulator, and logs out the serverResponseTimeByOrigin for the data URI origin. The output confirms the bug: data URIs incorrectly receive a non-zero server response time.
1.bug_scenario: When you feed a data-URI resource into the network simulator, it still picks up the default serverResponseTime (≈30 ms) even though data URIs are local and should never incur server latency. In your screenshot you can see additionalRtt is 0 (as expected) but responseTime is 30 for a data:image/png;base64… request.
